answer: The ember escrow is released only against a delta receipt, and the wharf audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 224 aliases means carrying 76 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. Submitting an answer locks 58 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 39 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
